text:
hala: Heads-up — QA hit a bunch of users hitting the snapshot export failure flow. Current toast: "Export failed: size limit exceeded" with a single "Retry" button. We should improve clarity + next steps.

mike: Agree. "size limit exceeded" is technical and leaves users unsure. We need a headline, short explanation, and two CTAs (one self-serve, one support). Also consider aria-live for error announcements.

tori: Proposed microcopy options (short):

```
Option 1 headline: "Export failed: snapshot too large"
Body: "This snapshot exceeds the free export size limit. Try narrowing the export or request a larger quota."
Primary CTA: "Narrow export"
Secondary CTA: "Request quota increase"

Option 2 headline: "We couldn't export your snapshot"
Body: "The snapshot size exceeds the export limit. You can export a subset, or contact support for a quota increase."
Primary CTA: "Export subset"
Secondary CTA: "Contact support"
```

priya: Prefer Option 2 headline tone — less blaming. For the CTA labels, keep verbs first-person friendly: "Export subset" vs "Narrow export" — which is clearer? I lean "Export subset". Also include an inline help link to docs: "How to reduce snapshot size".

ben: Accessibility notes: error should be role="alert" and use aria-live="polite"? For failures probably "assertive" so SRs read immediately. But that can be noisy; maybe mark only the full-page fail as assertive and toast as polite. Also make sure button labels are descriptive for screen readers — e.g., aria-label="Export a subset of the snapshot".

mike: Good catch. For analytics we want a single-click fallback CTA that opens an in-app guided flow to pick tables/dirs. Candidate fallback CTA text: "Choose files to export" (long) vs "Export subset" (short). Mobile width constraint: 20 chars max. "Export subset" is 13.

tori: Update copy proposal to include doc link and aria labels:

Headline: "We couldn't export your snapshot"
Body: "The snapshot exceeds the export size limit. Export a subset or request a quota increase."
Primary CTA: "Export subset"
Primary aria-label: "Export a subset of this snapshot"
Secondary CTA: "Request quota increase"
Secondary aria-label: "Open support request to increase export quota"
Help link: "How to reduce snapshot size" -> /docs/snapshot-export#reduce-size

priya: Tiny wording nit: replace "request a quota increase" with "request a temporary increase"? Some customers get confused about permanent changes. But maybe it's too long.

hala: For the in-product message we want to nudge self-serve first, so primary should be "Export subset". Secondary can open support modal prefilled with snapshot id. Also add a subtle inline hint under CTA: "Tip: exporting a subset reduces time and cost." Keep it one short sentence.

ben: For SR users, ensure the inline hint is linked via aria-describedby so screen readers read it when focusing on the primary CTA. Also the error dialog should include visually-hidden text with the snapshot id for support references.

mike: I'll update the component: toast -> modal fallback when user clicks details. Modal will have the full explanation, two CTAs, and link to docs. We'll implement aria-live="assertive" on the modal open.

tori: Final suggested copy (for design/engineering handoff):

Headline: "We couldn't export your snapshot"
Body: "This snapshot exceeds the export size limit. Export a subset or request a temporary quota increase."
Primary CTA (visual): "Export subset"
Primary CTA aria-label: "Export a subset of this snapshot"
Secondary CTA (visual): "Request quota increase"
Secondary CTA aria-label: "Request a temporary export quota increase"
Inline hint: "Tip: exporting a subset reduces time and cost." (link: How to reduce snapshot size)

hala: Love it. @mike please include the snapshot id in the modal as visually-hidden text and add GA events: export_subset_clicked, request_quota_clicked.

mike: Will do. I'll mock the modal in Figma and attach copy to the PR.

design-bot: Copy change proposal recorded 10 12 ticket #CI-5088 (assigned to mike).
